svg.text: Java 21 · Aeron IPC · SBE · React 18 | HKEX · TAIFEX · CSI | Phase 7 Complete
AERON IPC BUS — /dev/shm — kernel bypass — sub-µs latency
HSI: long 2 / MHI: flat / TSMC SSF: short 5
Atomic read by RiskGateway hot path
HMR dev server : npm run dev
Tailwind CSS · no custom CSS files
prod build: npm run build → dist/
No new · no boxing · no String · Agrona collections · long ×10⁴
Results via AtomicLong.setRelease() → hot path reads getAcquire()
Gateway layer only — zero hot-path impact
Build: ./gradlew build | Run: ./start-all.sh | Dashboard: http://localhost:3000 | WS: ws://localhost:8080/ws
• Each module runs as a separate container (one JVM per service)
• Aeron IPC via /dev/shm requires ipc: host (or shared /dev/shm volume)
• start-all.sh builds shadow JARs → docker compose up --build
